subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Expor resultados de pesquisa ou estudo com o apoio de recursos, tais como notas, gráficos, tabelas, entre outros, adequando as estratégias de construção do texto oral aos objetivos de comunicação e ao contexto.

components.description_pt: Selecionar e organizar anotações, gráficos ou tabelas para apoiar apresentação oral de pesquisa
components.description_en: Select and organize notes, graphs, or tables to support an oral research presentation
components.cc_component_description: Select relevant and descriptive facts to support the main idea of an oral presentation

components.description_pt: Adaptar organização, estilo e conteúdo de apresentação conforme seu propósito e audiência
components.description_en: Adapt the organization, style, and substance of a presentation to suit its purpose and audience
components.cc_component_description: Adapt the organization, style, and substance of a presentation to suit its purpose and audience

components.description_pt: Apresentar resultados de pesquisa ou estudo de forma clara e coerente para uma audiência
components.description_en: Present research or study findings clearly and coherently to an audience
components.cc_component_description: Present research-based knowledge synthesized from multiple sources in expressed arguments

components.description_pt: Integrar exibições visuais como gráficos ou imagens em apresentação para apoiar ideias-chave
components.description_en: Integrate visual displays such as graphics or images into a presentation to support key ideas
components.cc_component_description: Integrate visual displays such as graphics or images into a presentation to support key ideas

cc_matches.description: Include multimedia components (e.g., graphics, images, music, sound) and visual displays in presentations to clarify information.

Present information, findings, and supporting evidence, conveying a clear and distinct perspective, such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning, alternative or opposing perspectives are addressed, and the organization, development, substance, and style are appropriate to purpose, audience, and a range of formal and informal tasks.

Report on a topic or text, tell a story, or recount an experience in an organized manner, using appropriate facts and relevant, descriptive details to support main ideas or themes; speak clearly at an understandable pace.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar argumentos para...
* introducir y desarrollar declaraciones claras, precisas y coherentes
* ofrecer afirmaciones, contraposiciones, razonamiento válido y evidencia lógica
* establecer y mantener un estilo formal y un tono objetivo
* abogar por resoluciones con recomendaciones
* defender ideas centrales de textos multimodales bilingües haciendo énfasis en el desarrollo del razonamiento
* presentar conocimientos basados en investigaciones e ideas sintetizadas de varias fuentes
